data.content_ref: inline:Change the carrier of the fixed point from node labels to finite sets of support trees: a node is accepted iff it is the root of a tree whose leaves are committed roots and whose internal edges are warrants, and every attacker of any tree node is the root of no such tree. Define this by a monotone operator on the lattice of tree sets. Polynomiality holds when tree depth is bounded by node count and membership is decided by dynamic programming over a DAG of warrants. Criticizable because the tree-set lattice has exponential width, so canonicalization via deterministic hashing is needed and reinstatement may become non-local.
